summary: Revvity, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting Q2 2026 results and disclosed a definitive agreement signed July 31, 2026, to sell substantially all assets of its Immunodiagnostics business in China (China IDX) for up to $200 million, subject to adjustments and conditions. The company believes the sale will likely close by end of 2027, prompting inclusion of unaudited pro forma financials in the filing. No board recommendation or advisor named. The deal is an asset sale, with regulatory and closing conditions pending. Watch for closing conditions, adjustments to purchase price, and potential regulatory approval timeline.
